notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content: Last update for jumpo world is here, update 1.4. Includes a new leaderboard, lots of changes to mechanics as well as visual and sound updates.

notes.title: patch 1.3
notes.content: hi everyone. patch 1.3 includes plenty of bug fixes, new ui design (both in game & in the start menu) as well as several more levels added. enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: hello everyone. patch 1.2 is the biggest patch yet. includes a ton of bug fixes, adjustment to ui, gameplay adjustment and a bunch of new content (including new levels). hf!

notes.title: patch 1.1.5
notes.content: hello everyone. small update (no new content) that fixes a bunch of bugs and smoothens the gameplay. enjoy!

notes.title: patch 1.1
notes.content: patch 1.1 includes a bunch of bug fixes + new music added for every level + a bunch of sfx to increase overall experience. hf!

notes.title: small update
notes.content: hi! small update today. some minor bug-fixes (for example for the hookshot), and also added a leaderboard which will include the top 10 plays globally!
